content: Ethionamide is available under the brand name Trecator® in tablet form. Each tablet contains 250 mg of ethionamide and is orange in color with a film coating. The tablets are imprinted with the letter “W” on one side and the number “4117” on the opposite side. They are supplied in bottles containing 100 tablets. The product is identified by the National Drug Code (NDC) 0008-4117-01. It should be stored at a controlled room temperature of 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F) and dispensed in a tightly sealed container to maintain its stability and efficacy.
